verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, the same vendor toolchain that governs the Identity API. The pack shows no Identity-specific CLI commands, and the docs demonstrate Identity calls only via curl, so how well the CLI covers Identity is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that the CLI exposes Identity verification-session commands, CLI documentation depth or AI-oriented usage details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
